- 07/26: 49ers GM John Lynch reiterated the team is focused on players currently in camp, not WR Brandon Aiyuk, as his standoff with the team continues. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49449057/49ers-gm-lynch-focused-players-here-not-wr-aiyuk) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2081147672627405204)
